Stanbic IBTC Guaranteed Investment Fund

Highlights
  • The Stanbic IBTC Guaranteed Investment  Fund (SIGIF) was launched in December 2007
  • The Fund invests a minimum of 70% of its portfolio in bonds, a maximum of 10% in equities and a maximum of 30% in high quality money market instruments 
  • The Fund guarantees principal amount against diminution in value provided the investment is held for a minimum period of three months.
  • The Fund has a 91-day minimum holding period
  • The penalty for redeeming within the minimum holding period is 20% on the accrued income
  • The minimum investment amount is N5,000.00 
  • It is an open ended fund 
  • The risk profile is “Aggressive”
  • The management fee is 1.5% per annum
